question: How do the serpent kings praise the lord who transcends all remainder?
premises: Śeṣa and other serpent kings sing praise.
The addressed lord is called lord of remainder.
The lord is also beyond even that remainder.
inference: Serpent kings honor the deity as sovereign over and transcendent to all residual existence.
uncertainties: Exact nuance of kṛtaśeṣaśeṣam is interpretive.
plain_english: The serpent kings, led by Śeṣa, sing to you as the lord of the remainder and as the one who leaves even that remainder behind.
